svg.text: This award is proudly presented to:

text.tspan: In grateful recognition of your outstanding performance, unwavering dedication,
and exemplary service to the vision and goals of this institution.
Your exceptional contributions, leadership, and commitment to excellence
have set a distinguished standard of inspiration for colleagues, peers, and leadership alike.

svg.text: Presented this Day day of Month, Year
LEAD WITH PURPOSE • SERVE WITH EXCELLENCE • INSPIRE GENERATIONS
